title: Zamidar Haunt
game_overview: Explore an eerie abandoned Bangladeshi mansion, avoid the shadowy roaming Jinn, gather sacred protective scriptures, and unlock the escape gate.
winning_condition: Collect all 5 sacred protective scriptures hidden throughout the Zamidar Bari and unlock the front estate gates to escape.
losing_condition: Caught by the roaming Jinn when your fear reaches maximum or the entity intercepts you in the dark corridors.

controls.input: W / S / Up / Down / Virtual Left Joystick
controls.action: Walk forward or backward along 3D hallways (-Z / +Z).

controls.input: A / D / Left / Right / Virtual Left Joystick
controls.action: Strafe left or right laterally across mansion rooms (-X / +X).

controls.input: Mouse Drag / Right Touch Area / Look Joystick
controls.action: First-person camera pitch and yaw rotation to look around 3D space.
Inspect furniture, collect glowing protective scriptures, and open doors.
Toggle handheld flashlight on and off to conserve battery and manage stealth.
Sprint briefly to outrun the Jinn when detected at the cost of stamina.

sections.title: Design Pillars
sections.content: 1. Authentic Bengali Gothic Horror: Traditional Zamidar Bari architecture featuring arched colonnades, courtyard corridors, weathered terracotta bricks, ornate wooden chests, and candle shrines. 2. Claustrophobic Darkness & Light Management: Tactical reliance on a handheld dynamic flashlight with real-time flickering when supernatural threats draw near. 3. Stealth, Tension, and Ancient Lore: Avoiding the predatory roaming Jinn while searching shadowy furniture and rooms for 5 glowing protective scriptures to banish the gateway seal.
sections.summary: Core emotional and atmospheric pillars of the survival horror experience.

sections.title: Core Loop
sections.content: Spawn in the grand courtyard of the decaying Zamidar Bari -> Navigate dark corridors and ornate ancestral rooms with flashlight -> Monitor whispering audio and flashlight glitching cues to evade the roaming Jinn -> Search furniture and altars to collect 5 sacred protective scriptures -> Rush back to the main estate wrought-iron gates to break the supernatural seal and escape.
sections.summary: Exploration, stealth evasion, scripture discovery, and escape loop.

sections.title: Core Mechanics
sections.content: 1. First-Person Locomotion: Smooth WASD/touch movement and mouse/drag camera look with head-bobbing and footstep audio. 2. Handheld 3D Flashlight: Directional spotlight mounted to view with battery drain, toggleable states, and proximity-based flickering when within 12 units of the Jinn. 3. Jinn Patrol & Hunt AI: Shadowy ethereal entity with red burning eyes that patrols mansion waypoints, switches to hunt mode on seeing player or hearing running, and warps room lighting. 4. Protective Scripture Shrines: 5 distinct sacred scrolls emitting subtle golden particles and sacred aura hidden in cupboards, chests, and ancestral tables. 5. Sanity & Fear System: Proximity to Jinn causes screen chromatic aberration, heartbeat thumps, and whispering audio.
sections.summary: First-person exploration, flashlight mechanics, stealth evasion, and item collection.

sections.title: 3D Camera & Movement Alignment
sections.content: 3D Coordinate System: Standard Three.js right-handed coordinate convention (+Y is Up, +X is Right, -Z is Forward). Camera Perspective: First-person camera positioned at eye level (Y = 1.7m), with smooth yaw and pitch clamping (-85 to +85 degrees) driven by pointer lock or touch look gestures. Movement Dynamics: Kinematic first-person controller with collision bounds, walking speed of 3.8 units/sec, sprint speed of 6.2 units/sec, and smooth deceleration.
sections.summary: First-person perspective with standard Three.js right-handed coordinate space.

sections.title: 3D Scene Hierarchy & Lighting Mandates
sections.content: Atmospheric Aesthetic: Moody midnight storm over a rural estate with dark blue ambient illumination, moonlight pouring through broken skylights, and warm flicker from wall oil lanterns. Interactive Geometry: Ornate wooden almirahs (wardrobes), antique four-poster beds, vintage chairs, terracotta pillars, arched doorways, and glowing scroll pedestals. Visual Hazard Affordance: The roaming Jinn radiates a distinct dark smokey silhouette with glowing crimson eyes and distorting aura. UI & HUD Overlay Integration: Battery meter, stamina bar, scriptures collected counter (0/5), fear meter, and interaction crosshair placed in safe border zones with semi-transparent dark backdrops.
sections.summary: Atmospheric midnight Bangladeshi manor lighting with volumetric spotlights.

sections.title: Characters & Enemies
sections.content: Player: First-person paranormal investigator with 3D flashlight and stamina. The Jinn (Chhayatmar): A terrifying tall towering shadowy wraith with flowing smokey shroud, horned silhouette, glowing crimson eyes, and hovering levitation animation. When chasing, its aura creates heavy room distortion and whispering soundscapes.
sections.summary: The vulnerable investigator and the ethereal roaming Jinn entity.

sections.title: Fairness Tools
sections.content: Flashlight flickering intensity and auditory whisper distance scale smoothly based on Jinn distance, providing early warning so the player can hide in shadowy corners or retreat into adjacent rooms.
sections.summary: Clear audiovisual cues and proximity warnings.

sections.title: Juice & Game Feel
sections.content: Anticipation Juice: Flashlight beam tremors, creaking floorboards, and subtle ambient cricket and wind howling. State Change Juice: Sudden flickering light strobe, rapid heartbeat audio, and screen edge vignette darkening when the Jinn detects the player. Impact Juice: Screen chromatic shake and chilling stinger when spotted, accompanied by radiant golden light explosion upon collecting a protective scripture.
sections.summary: High tension horror feedback and atmospheric juice.

sections.title: Social Mechanics & Audience
sections.content: Designed for survival horror and folklore mystery fans. Features randomized scripture spawn locations across runs and speedrun escape time leaderboards via the Playground SDK.

sections.title: Accessibility
sections.content: Visual threat radar/indicator option for hearing-impaired players, adjustable mouse/touch sensitivity, and high-contrast UI toggle.

sections.title: Structural Integrity
sections.content: Main Menu (Bengali Gothic Title & Lore Intro) -> 3D Mansion Investigation -> In-Game Pause -> Victory Screen (Escaped the Bari with Best Time) / Game Over Screen (Claimed by the Jinn). Full restart and state reset capabilities.
sections.summary: State machine and game loop flow.

sections.title: Virtual Touch Controls Implementation
sections.content: When mobile device is detected via useIsMobile(), render a virtual floating movement joystick on the bottom-left and dedicated touch buttons (Interact, Flashlight, Sprint) on the bottom-right. Buttons have touch-none class, high z-index, and pointer-events-auto with onPointerDown/Up/Leave/Cancel handlers to avoid stuck states.
sections.summary: Responsive mobile controls with virtual joystick and action buttons.
